anomalies.description: A woman fires a handgun in a confined corridor; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at 2.0s–2.5s, followed by debris and dust cloud indicating impact/explosion from the shot.

A sudden blast occurs after the gunshot, producing a bright flash, expanding smoke/fireball, and flying debris (e.g., wall fragments), consistent with an explosive detonation triggered by the shot or nearby ordnance.

After the second shot, a person is seen slumped on the floor (visible in f10–f11), appearing incapacitated and helpless while the shooter stands over them; this constitutes abuse if the victim is defenseless and the act is non-consensual violence.
A woman fires a handgun at close range; visible muzzle flash and smoke emanate from the barrel as she aims directly forward.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical confrontation: one raises his hand in a defensive or striking motion while the other leans in aggressively; a third person is visible behind them observing.
A visible muzzle flash and smoke erupt from a firearm held by a figure on the right (f5), indicating an active discharge of the weapon.
A woman and a man engage in close-quarters physical struggle; the woman grabs the man's arm while he leans in, indicating mutual combat.

The man forcefully grabs the woman by the neck/throat with his hand, lifting or restraining her; she appears distressed and unable to resist effectively, indicating an attack on a vulnerable person.; The woman is shown being forcibly restrained or choked by the assailant, with her head tilted back and mouth open in distress—indicating she is helpless and under attack.; A person lies motionless on the floor while another stands over them holding a weapon; later, a second person on the floor appears to be struggling or injured, suggesting ongoing coercion or assault of helpless individuals.
A woman is engaged in close-quarters physical struggle with an assailant; she appears to be resisting, with her arms raised and body tensed, while the assailant grips her.
A muzzle flash is visible at the end of a firearm held by the man, directed toward the woman, consistent with a gunshot being fired in the immediate frame.
A man lies motionless on the floor, suggesting he has been incapacitated; another person is positioned over him in a manner consistent with post-assault control or abuse.

A muzzle flash is visible from a firearm held by a standing figure in the background, indicating a shot was fired during this interval.; A muzzle flash is visible from a firearm held by a standing figure, indicating a shot was fired.
A man is on the ground, visibly injured and struggling, while a woman stands over him holding a firearm; his posture and facial expression indicate he is helpless and being threatened or attacked.

The woman raises and aims a handgun directly forward; frames f9–f15 show her in a clear aiming stance with the gun pointed, consistent with an imminent or ongoing discharge (though muzzle flash is not visible, the sustained aiming posture in a tense context supports shooting intent/act).
